author: JerryRigEverything
description:
We have completely Redesigned our Off-Road Wheelchair, making it better in every way - and it is available right now: https://www.notawheelchair.com/products/the-rig-2-0 We have three different options this year.  A 2 wheel drive version called The Rig. A four wheel drive version called The BIG RIG, and brand new this year we will have a 3rd version with super torque motors in the back called GIGA-RIG.  Its pretty insane. 

Learn more about the ADA and OPDMD's here: https://www.ada.gov/resources/opdmds/

Thank you so much for your support!
title: Our NEW Off Road Wheelchair can now CLIMB STAIRS!
